mapper.select: SELECT c.*, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_likes cl WHERE cl.content_id = c.content_id), 0) AS like_count, 0 AS view_count, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_places cp WHERE cp.content_id = c.content_id), 0) AS related_place_count, FALSE AS is_liked FROM contents c WHERE #{keyword} = '' OR c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.cast_names LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY c.is_popular DESC, c.created_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT p.*, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_likes pl WHERE pl.place_id = p.place_id), 0) AS like_count, FALSE AS is_liked, NULL AS visit_status FROM places p WHERE #{keyword} = '' OR p.place_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.region LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.district LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY p.region ASC, p.place_name ASC LIMIT 20
